MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Hillman anchors and screws felt like a natural next choice because I recently looked at a drywall anchor kit and could use similar supplies for small mounting jobs.",
    "The anchors paired with screws matched my interest in fastening things securely more closely than the other recommendations did."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Caulk, caulk caps, and glue would require sealing or bonding projects that I do not currently have; my recent fastening purchases do not imply those needs.",
    "Brads and finish nails look related to framing nails, but their purpose and tool requirements differ, so I would not choose them without a matching project and compatible tool.",
    "The security signs did not connect to any current need shown by my recent mounting supplies or household maintenance purchases."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in fastening supplies seemed to be stretched into an interest in almost any home repair product.",
    "Different kinds of nails seemed to be treated as interchangeable even though framing, finishing, and brad nailing serve different jobs."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The specific purpose, dimensions, gauge, and collation of my recent fasteners matter because a related-looking product may not fit the same tool or task.",
    "I choose supplies when they meet a current need; large packs and multiple bottles are not appealing just because they might be useful someday.",
    "My medicine cups and vacuum bags reflect separate practical needs, so I would not interpret every recent purchase as part of one repair project."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in fastening and mounting but extended it too broadly to unrelated repair supplies and fasteners for different jobs."
}
